A) Always reset filters on a workspace switch, with no setting needed. This fixes hidden rows by default.

B) Add a resolver-owned setting such as `resetFiltersOnWorkspaceChange`, defaulting to reset. Users who want filters to carry over can opt in.

C) Keep filters across switches, but show a clear "N rows hidden by filters" indicator with a one-click clear. The setting would control only whether the indicator appears.

D) Other: name it.

Recommendation: B - it fixes the reported hidden-rows problem by default and still lets users keep filters across switches, through the resolver we just chose.
